fields.Name: T119 - AI Agents Category Tree-Dropdown Filter
fields.Description: Tests the bespoke mj-tree-dropdown projected as a custom widget inside mj-filter-panel (Category), a unique filter control not present in the generic entity grid advanced-filter panel.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Agents section. Click the Filter button/icon in the toolbar to open the filter popover. Inside the popover, find the Category filter - it is a tree-style dropdown (folder-tree). Open it and pick a category value, then confirm the agents list responds. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the filter popover renders its fields (including the Category tree-dropdown) and applying a category either narrows the agent list to matches OR shows a clear no-match/empty state.

judgeValidationCriteria: The filter popover opens and displays filter fields including a Category tree-style dropdown widget
Selecting a category value causes the agent list to update (narrow to matches) or show a clear no-results state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
